info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List E Branch Operation Status-spec
info.description: The E-Branch Operation Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of various e-branch services. It allows businesses to monitor and retrieve the current state of e-branch operations, facilitating proactive management and decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include banking professionals and IT teams who need to assess system availability and performance. By using this API, organizations can enhance their service reliability and user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of e-branch operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of e-branch operations, providing insight into their availability and performance. Use this to monitor the operational health of e-branches.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of specific e-branch operations. It requires a JSON formatted input that conforms to the specified schema, which outlines the necessary parameters and expected structure for the operation.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the status information is returned.
